methodologyNotes: Re-verified adversarially via direct WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (hightouch.com/pricing, rudderstack.com/pricing, fivetran.com/pricing, polytomic.com/pricing, omnata.com/pricing/sync-for-snowflake, skyvia.com/pricing) plus each vendor's security page for compliance. All paid-plan monthlyUsd values were confirmed against published prices; quote-only/usage-based tiers are recorded as monthlyUsd:null with billingModel custom (a null beats a guess). KEY CORRECTIONS vs the draft: (1) Polytomic's 'Basic $500/month flat' plan was FABRICATED — the page publishes only 'Pricing begins at $500/month' as a floor, and the real tiers (Standard, Enterprise) are both contact-sales; replaced with a null-priced Standard tier. (2) Skyvia Basic additional-records overage corrected from $0.06/1K (which is the Free-tier rate) to $0.02/1K. Census (getcensus.com -> 301 fivetran.com) was acquired by Fivetran (announced May 1, 2025) and is sold as Fivetran Activations; Grouparoo (acquired by Airbyte, 2022) excluded. No vendors removed (both already excluded by writer). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

The third-party 'Growth $1,000/month' figure (costbench-style) is NOT on Hightouch's official page, so it remains monthlyUsd:null. Compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2 & SOC 3, HIPAA, GDPR) confirmed on the pricing page.

vendors.name: Omnata
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched omnata.com/pricing/sync-for-snowflake on 2026-06-15. Omnata is a Snowflake Native App billed per-plugin per-day (flat fee per active sync-direction, billed monthly by Snowflake); no traditional monthly subscription tiers. Verified sample rates: HubSpot/Salesforce CRM $6.50/day initial + $3.00/day additional direction; Marketo $10/day; Microsoft SQL Server from $14/day; MySQL/PostgreSQL from $10/day. Google Sheets and Slack plugins are $0/day. No compliance certifications explicitly stated on the fetched page; left null.
